Senses.Explanation: Shariputra is a named disciple whom Chan masters repeatedly place inside questions, reversals, comparisons, and inherited public cases. Yongming Yanshou cites Shariputra asking for a concise statement of dependent arising. Tianyin Yuanxiu, Yuanwu Keqin, and Dahui Zonggao raise exchanges in which Shariputra questions Moon-above Woman, Subhuti, or a heavenly woman and is answered or reversed. The entry defines the figure through these Chan deployments and does not import the unattested title “foremost in wisdom.”
